usedFor: Fluent Forms collects website submissions, and Moco receives them as work through “Create Task” or “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Fluent Forms, then “Create Deal” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: An enquiry form is where leads begin, and the action creates a lead with contact and company.

watchOut: “Create Task” in Moco creates a task inside a project, so the form must say which project.
